question: The __________ is the area of the earth where living organisms can be found or where life can be sustained.
solution:
The correct answer is __**biosphere.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biosphere refers to the part of the earth where living organisms can be found **or **where life can be sustained**. It includes all living things on earth, including humans, animals, plants, and microorganisms.
 
• It is **made up of various ecosystems**, such as forests, oceans, grasslands, and deserts, that interact with each other and with the physical environment.
 
• It is essential for the survival of all living organisms on earth, as it provides us with food, water, air, and other resources.
 
• It is constantly changing and evolving, and human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and climate change, are having a significant impact on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **atmosphere refers to the layer of gases that surrounds the earth **and is composed of several different layers, including the troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, thermosphere, and exosphere.
 
• The **toposphere refers to the lowest layer of the earth's atmosphere**, where weather occurs and most of the air we breathe is located.
 
• The **stratosphere **is the layer of the earth's atmosphere that is located above the troposphere and **contains the ozone layer**.
